answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 36179 Country: Pakistan Title: I want to know the meaning of girl name Anabia and also want to know can I give this name to my daughter as someone told me that this is not a name whereas I searched this name through Muslim names website Question: I want to know the meaning of girl name Anabia and also want to know can I give this name to my daughter as someone told me that this is not a name whereas I searched this name through Muslim names website. Now my daughter is three months old and someone is saying that this is not a name and someone told me that this is an Arabic name. Answer ID: 36179 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 189/189/M=1433) The word Inabiyah (اِنابیہ) is an Arabic word which means one who turns towards Allah. You can give this name to your daughter. You can choose any other meaningful name if you are not satisfied. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
